title: 第85章 冲榜首第84章 地下魔窟
content_zh:
“魔王已经击毙！其他组什么情况？”
“一组已经完成对正面营地的清理，全歼敌人。”
“二组完成左侧敌人的围杀，无一逃脱。”
“三组对右侧敌人全体歼灭，无人受伤。”
……
战斗比预想的还要简单一些，虽然说魔军的战斗人员看起来数量不少，但其实都是低阶的魔修，法器简陋，战斗力很差，比他们预备役的战士还要差，是炮灰中的炮灰。
那魔王的反应也相当迟钝，石乐志瞬间杀到他们开会的石屋时，他们还没反应过来，等反抗了两下，发现情况不妙要逃走时，已经来不及了。
“碾压式狂胜，只有十九人受伤，没有阵亡。”汇总战报的时候，石乐志对此次战斗结果还算满意。
“这些平民如何处置？”
四周山洞还有几万没有战斗力的平民，他们魔化程度不算严重，还有净化恢复的机会。
石乐志看了看，“都埋了吧，他们只是没有修炼天赋，并不是不想入魔。”
这是一个族群，自己已经把他们族中的战士都屠杀干净了，在心里肯定已经种下仇恨，如果就这样放任他们离开，以后又不知会引来什么后患。
“入魔族群，一律斩杀！”这本来就是龙族军部发布的指令，他们也觉得这样处理没问题。
当初他们帮助魔军驱逐，屠杀龙族平民的时候，也一点没有留情。
石乐志抬起左手，在腕表上进行一番输入操作，把此次清剿地下魔窟的战斗过程视频以及详细战情，都上传回龙族军部系统。
很快系统传回来确认信息。
“三十四万六千七百积分，今天的收成相当不错！”
“排名上升到三十九名了，后面的积分都相差不大，一万积分就能上升好几个名次呢，我们要再来一次大清剿，直接就进前十了。”
从九十多一下子提升到三十九名，他们的排名暴涨，引来了其他军团的关注。
刚从地下魔窟返回地面，石乐志的几个聊天群，就传来一阵阵呼喊。

“石统领，你们找到地下魔军大部队了？怎么一下子积分涨了几十万？”
“石哥，这么大一块肥肉，居然不声不响的独吞，也太不讲义气了，下次有这样的好事，关照一下兄弟们啊。”
“走狗屎运了？石统领，你在哪个位置找到的魔窟啊？看战报，你们这一下清剿了四万多的魔人啊。”
“现在斩杀魔军容易，但是找到它们可就太难了，我都用了一百多张遁地符了，硬是没有摸到一点魔军的踪迹。”
“我也十六天没有开张了啊！好烦，排名一路往下掉，石统领，有什么寻找魔军的秘法，透露一下啊，你们沉寂了两个月，怎么一下子搞出这么个大阵仗来，肯定不是运气使然。”
“我们也半个月没有摸过魔人军团了，大家有什么信息共享一下啊，地面魔军的围剿也行，地下搜索太难了。”
“再没有进展，我们就要到前线去混一混了。”
石乐志嘴很严，肯定不会把自家的秘密透露出去，有石小军的这个天道法器在，他们以后就是地下魔窟的克星，就算是深入到地下五十公里，他们都能把魔军残余揪出来清理干净。
他在几个群都回了一句，“哈哈，运气，运气！大家继续努力。”
石小军回到营地里休息，这一战就数他消耗最大，带着军团在地下穿梭几百里，就是不小的损耗。
之后几天时间，他继续带着百人小队追杀魔军小股残余，毕竟这些才是占据地下魔窟主要群体的大头，整个部族迁入地下修建地下城的属于小概率事件。
小股魔军的积分也就从几万到几千不等，也不是每支军团每天都能碰上的，缺乏地下搜索目标的手段，可能连续十几天都碰不到目标，白忙碌一场。
而石小军带队，起码每天至少有三场战斗，这还是他消耗大，没能继续搜索下去的结果，如果每天出战十二个小时，他们能一天战五场以上。
战斗是最简单的事，搜索反而是最消耗精力和时间的。
七天之后，就凭着这些小规模的战斗积分，他们也稳稳的冲进了前五，距离第一名也只有不到二十万的积分了。
“马上要季度结算了，加把劲，要是能冲到第一就好了。实在不行，前三也不错。”
到了这个位置，每前进一名，都是另一个层次的奖励，第一名尤其是高规格奖励。
领地封赏令就是其中一个奖励。
现在他们石家已经可以通过军功来获得一块新领地了，但他们并不会嫌弃领地太多。
“冲一冲吧，如果能够再找到一个地下魔城……”石家长老们都很期待，但这需要一些运气。

石小军展开军情地图，上面已经显示了许多地下搜索过的范围，都是经过军部系统汇总各支军团的搜索情况，全部录入这张地图中，而可以看到，整个万柱群山地下区域的二十公里范围内，都几乎被搜了个遍，没有遗漏。
“要么是再深入搜索，要么是转移位置，到云雾群山那片区域，听说那里最近也是战果不错，许多军团都有收获。”石乐志在群里收到许多反馈信息，加上积分榜上的变化也很清晰。
“我觉得还是要再深入一些，我感觉这下面还有大鱼的。”石小军主动提出自己的意见，因为他的搜索信息更加清晰，他可以从那些大规模的魔族迁移留下的痕迹，推断出应该还有几股大型部族往更深处的地下转移。
“再往下就是神识搜索也无法深入的密岩区，小军你搜索这些区域也消耗巨大吧，如果得不偿失，那我们转移战区是最好的办法。”
这是一个效率的问题，因为密岩区的搜索消耗巨大，那每天能搜寻的范围就变小，获得敌人信息就更少了，还不如去新的区域进行搜索，这样更容易得到敌人信息，几天高效追杀，也能冲一冲第一名。
content_en:
"The Demon King has been killed! What's going on with the other groups?"
"One group has completed clearing the front camp and wiped out all the enemies."
"The second group completed the encirclement and killing of the enemies on the left, and no one escaped."
"The three groups annihilated all the enemies on the right, and no one was injured."
…
The battle was simpler than expected. Although the combatants of the Demon Army seemed to be in large numbers, they were actually low-level demon cultivators with crude weapons and poor combat effectiveness. They were even worse than their reserve warriors. They were cannon fodder among cannon fodder.
The demon king's reaction was also quite slow. When Shi Lezhi instantly killed them at the stone house where they were meeting, they had not yet reacted. After resisting for a few times and realizing that the situation was not good and trying to escape, it was already too late.
"A crushing victory. Only nineteen people were injured and no one was killed." When summarizing the battle report, Shi Lezhi was quite satisfied with the result of the battle.
"What to do with these civilians?"
There are tens of thousands of civilians without fighting power in the surrounding caves. Their degree of demonization is not serious, and they still have a chance to be purified and recovered.
Shi Lezhi looked at them and said, "Bury them all. They just don't have the talent to practice. It's not that they don't want to be possessed by demons."
This is a ethnic group. He has slaughtered all the warriors in their tribe, and he must have planted hatred in his heart. If he just lets them leave like this, he doesn't know what troubles it will cause in the future.
"Kill all the demonic tribes!" This was originally the order issued by the Dragon Clan Military Headquarters, and they thought it was okay to handle them this way.
When they helped the demon army expel and massacre the dragon civilians, they showed no mercy at all.
Shi Lezhi raised his left hand, performed some input operations on his watch, and uploaded the video of the battle to clear the underground demon cave and the detailed battle situation back to the Dragon Clan military system.
The system will soon send back confirmation information.
"Three hundred and forty-six thousand, seven hundred points, today's harvest is quite good!"
"The ranking has risen to thirty-nine. The points behind are not much different. Ten thousand points can rise several places. We will have another big cleanup and we will enter the top ten directly."
Suddenly promoted from more than ninety to thirty-nine, their ranking skyrocketed, attracting the attention of other legions.
As soon as he returned to the surface from the underground devil's cave, shouts came from several chat groups of Shi Lezhi.
"Commander Shi, have you found the underground demon army? Why did your points suddenly increase by hundreds of thousands?"
"Brother Shi, it's so unloyal to swallow such a big piece of fat without saying a word. Next time something good like this happens, please take care of your brothers."
"Are you lucky? Commander Shi, where did you find the demon cave? Looking at the battle report, you have wiped out more than 40,000 demons in one go."
"It is easy to kill the demon army now, but it is too difficult to find them. I have used more than a hundred earth escape talismans, but I can't find any trace of the demon army."
"I haven't opened for sixteen days! It's so annoying. My ranking has dropped all the way. Commander Shi, please tell me if you have any secret method for finding the demon army. You guys have been silent for two months. Why did you come up with such a big battle all of a sudden? It's definitely not luck."
"We haven't touched the demon army in half a month. Do you have any information to share? The ground demon army can also be encircled and suppressed. It is too difficult to search underground."
"If there is no progress, we will go to the front line to hang out."
Shi Lezhi is very strict and will definitely not reveal his secrets. With Shi Xiaojun's heavenly weapon, they will be the nemesis of the underground demon cave in the future. Even if they go fifty kilometers underground, they can dig out the remnants of the demon army and clean them up.
He replied in several groups, "Haha, luck, luck! Everyone, keep working hard."
Shi Xiaojun returned to the camp to rest. This battle was the biggest drain on him. He led the legion underground for hundreds of miles, which was a lot of losses.
In the next few days, he continuedHe continued to lead a squad of a hundred people to hunt down the remnants of the demon army. After all, these were the main groups occupying the underground demon cave. It was a small probability event that the entire tribe would move underground to build a dungeon.
The points of a small army of demons range from tens to thousands, and not every legion can encounter them every day. Without the means to search for targets underground, they may not be able to encounter targets for more than ten days in a row, and their busy work is in vain.
Shi Xiaojun led the team and had at least three battles every day. This was because he was exhausted and could not continue searching. If they fought for twelve hours a day, they could fight more than five battles a day.
Fighting is the simplest thing, but searching consumes the most energy and time.
Seven days later, relying on these small-scale battle points, they had firmly entered the top five, and were less than 200,000 points away from first place.
"The quarterly settlement is coming soon. Work harder. It would be great if we can reach the first place. If it doesn't work out, the top three is not bad either."
At this position, every time you advance one place, it will be another level of reward, especially the first place, especially the high-level reward.
Territory reward order is one of the rewards.
Now the Shi family can obtain a new territory through military merit, but they will not dislike having too much territory.
"Let's go for it. If we can find another underground magic city..." The elders of Shi Family are all looking forward to it, but this requires some luck.
Shi Xiaojun unfolded the military information map, which already showed many underground search areas. The search status of each legion was compiled through the military system, and all were entered into this map. It can be seen that the entire 20-kilometer range of the underground area of ​​​​Wanzhu Mountains has been searched almost everywhere, and no one was missed.
"Either search in depth, or move to the Yunwu Mountains area. I heard that the results there have been good recently, and many legions have gained." Shi Lezhi received a lot of feedback in the group, and the changes in the standings were also very clear.
"I think we need to go deeper. I feel like there are big fish down here." Shi Xiaojun took the initiative to offer his opinion, because his search information was clearer. He could infer from the traces left by the large-scale migration of demons that there should be several large tribes moving deeper underground.
"Further down is the dense rock area that cannot be penetrated by spiritual search. Xiaojun, you will also consume a lot of money to search these areas. If the gains outweigh the losses, then our best way is to transfer the war zone."
This is a question of efficiency, because the search in the dense rock area consumes a lot of money, so the range that can be searched every day becomes smaller, and less enemy information is obtained. It is better to search in new areas, which makes it easier to obtain enemy information. After a few days of efficient pursuit, you can also rush to the first place.
